tutorial.title: React JS Crash Course
tutorial.selection_reason: Covers JSX, components and props end to end without assuming prior framework experience.

coverage.summary: A complete introduction to React: JSX syntax, function components, props and rendering lists.

questions.question: What is React primarily used for?
questions.correct_answer_explanation: React is a library for building user interfaces from components.

questions.question: In JSX, how do you embed a JavaScript expression?
questions.correct_answer_explanation: JSX evaluates any expression placed inside single curly braces.

project_result.title: Build a Component-Driven To-Do App
project_result.overview: Create a small to-do application built from reusable React components.
project_result.activity_context: You have learned JSX, components and props. This puts all three together in one app.
project_result.learning_objective: Compose a UI from small components and pass data between them with props.
tasks: Create a TaskList component that renders an array of tasks
Create a TaskItem component that receives one task as a prop
Add a form that appends a new task
technical_requirements: Every list item must have a stable key
deliverables: A README explaining how to start it
acceptance_criteria: Tasks render from an array rather than being hard coded
The empty state shows a message
